title: Workspace trust decided once, not per flag
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Derive trust for headless agents from repo ownership and an explicit one-time 'susi trust', instead of hardcoding --trust in adapters. Tests zc_workspace_trust_*.
